_about: The blog's editorial plan (docs/14 §10). Edit by hand to add or reorder planned posts; `npm run blog-plan` adds each published post's follow-up here automatically and rewrites the calendar in docs/14 from this file and the posts. `slug` is the post's file name once written; `from` is the post whose follow-up an entry is.
